q-0282.answer:
Surah Al-Ankaboot (29) — The Spider · 69 ayahs · Meccan

Main teachings:
• Only to see – because seeing has to do with what is there, but knowledge is broader than seeing, since it includes what is not present as well as what is.
• One of those who will be destroyed, because she used to support them in their disbelief and wrongdoing.
• Those who turn away from the truth, turning a blind eye to clear evidence, being stubborn and arrogant.
• He will make know which are sincere in their claim to be believers from those who are lying.

Full ayah text and tafsir are available in the sources below.

sources.snippet: Quran 29:1. Arabic: بِسْمِ ٱللَّهِ ٱلرَّحْمَٰنِ ٱلرَّحِيمِ الٓمٓ. English: Alif, Lam, Meem. Urdu: الم.

Quran 29:2. Arabic: أَحَسِبَ ٱلنَّاسُ أَن يُتْرَكُوٓا۟ أَن يَقُولُوٓا۟ ءَامَنَّا وَهُمْ لَا يُفْتَنُونَ. English: Do the people think that they will be left to say, "We believe" and they will not be tried?. Urdu: کیا لوگ یہ خیال کئے ہوئے ہیں کہ صرف یہ کہنے سے کہ ہم ایمان لے آئے چھوڑ دیئے جائیں گے اور اُن کی آزمائش نہیں کی جائے گی.

Quran 29:3. Arabic: وَلَقَدْ فَتَنَّا ٱلَّذِينَ مِن قَبْلِهِمْ ۖ فَلَيَعْلَمَنَّ ٱللَّهُ ٱلَّذِينَ صَدَقُوا۟ وَلَيَعْلَمَنَّ ٱلْكَٰذِبِينَ. English: But We have certainly tried those before them, and Allah will surely make evident those who are truthful, and He will surely make evident the liars.. Urdu: اور جو لوگ اُن سے پہلے ہو چکے ہیں ہم نے اُن کو بھی آزمایا تھا (اور ان کو بھی آزمائیں گے) سو خدا اُن کو ضرور معلوم کریں گے جو (اپنے ایمان میں) سچے ہیں اور اُن کو بھی جو جھوٹے ہیں.

Quran 29:34. Arabic: إِنَّا مُنزِلُونَ عَلَىٰٓ أَهْلِ هَٰذِهِ ٱلْقَرْيَةِ رِجْزًۭا مِّنَ ٱلسَّمَآءِ بِمَا كَانُوا۟ يَفْسُقُونَ. English: Indeed, we will bring down on the people of this city punishment from the sky because they have been defiantly disobedient.". Urdu: ہم اس بستی کے رہنے والوں پر اس سبب سے کہ یہ بدکرداری کرتے رہے ہیں آسمان سے عذاب نازل کرنے والے ہیں.

q-0284.answer:
Surah Ar-Room (30) — The Romans · 60 ayahs · Meccan

Main teachings:
• The Command to adhere to Tawhid
• Bear their stubborn opposition with patience, for Allah will fulfill His promise to grant you victory over them and cause you and those who follow you to prevail in this world and in the Hereafter.
• Alif, Lam, Meem.
• The Byzantines have been defeated
• In the nearest land. But they, after their defeat, will overcome.

Full ayah text and tafsir are available in the sources below.

q-0285.answer: Scholars classify the 114 surahs by where they were first revealed: approximately **86 surahs are Meccan** (revealed before Hijrah in Makkah) and **28 are Medinan** (revealed after Hijrah in Madinah). Meccan surahs often focus on faith, tawhid, and the Hereafter; Medinan surahs often address law, community, and governance. Individual surah pages show each surah's revelation type.

Surah Luqman (31) — Luqman · 34 ayahs · Meccan

Main teachings:
• Whoever does this is one of those of whom
• His knowledge is subtle, for nothing is hidden from Him, no matter how small, subtle and minute.
• One who shows off and admires himself, feeling that he is better than others.

q-0289.answer: Scholars classify the 114 surahs by where they were first revealed: approximately **86 surahs are Meccan** (revealed before Hijrah in Makkah) and **28 are Medinan** (revealed after Hijrah in Madinah). Meccan surahs often focus on faith, tawhid, and the Hereafter; Medinan surahs often address law, community, and governance. Individual surah pages show each surah's revelation type.

Surah As-Sajda (32) — The Prostration · 30 ayahs · Meccan

Main teachings:
• They pray the voluntary night prayer and forego sleep and resting on a comfortable bed.
• Their hearts believed in the signs of Allah, and they did as the signs of Allah dictate, i.

• We shall avenge Ourselves on those who do that in the strongest possible terms.

Full ayah text and tafsir are available in the sources below.

sources.snippet: Quran 32:1. Arabic: بِسْمِ ٱللَّهِ ٱلرَّحْمَٰنِ ٱلرَّحِيمِ الٓمٓ. English: Alif, Lam, Meem.. Urdu: الٓمٓ.

Quran 32:2. Arabic: تَنزِيلُ ٱلْكِتَٰبِ لَا رَيْبَ فِيهِ مِن رَّبِّ ٱلْعَٰلَمِينَ. English: [This is] the revelation of the Book about which there is no doubt from the Lord of the worlds.. Urdu: اس میں کچھ شک نہیں کہ اس کتاب کا نازل کیا جانا تمام جہان کے پروردگار کی طرف سے ہے.

Quran 32:3. Arabic: أَمْ يَقُولُونَ ٱفْتَرَىٰهُ ۚ بَلْ هُوَ ٱلْحَقُّ مِن رَّبِّكَ لِتُنذِرَ قَوْمًۭا مَّآ أَتَىٰهُم مِّن نَّذِيرٍۢ مِّن قَبْلِكَ لَعَلَّهُمْ يَهْتَدُونَ. English: Or do they say, "He invented it"? Rather, it is the truth from your Lord, [O Muhammad], that you may warn a people to whom no warner has come before you [so] perhaps they will be guided.. Urdu: کیا یہ لوگ یہ کہتے ہیں کہ پیغمبر نے اس کو از خود بنا لیا ہے (نہیں) بلکہ وہ تمہارے پروردگار کی طرف سے برحق ہے تاکہ تم ان لوگوں کو ہدایت کرو جن کے پاس تم سے پہلے کوئی ہدایت کرنے والا نہیں آیا تاکہ یہ رستے پر چلیں.

Quran 32:15. Arabic: إِنَّمَا يُؤْمِنُ بِـَٔايَٰتِنَا ٱلَّذِينَ إِذَا ذُكِّرُوا۟ بِهَا خَرُّوا۟ سُجَّدًۭا وَسَبَّحُوا۟ بِحَمْدِ رَبِّهِمْ وَهُمْ لَا يَسْتَكْبِرُونَ ۩. English: Only those believe in Our verses who, when they are reminded by them, fall down in prostration and exalt [Allah] with praise of their Lord, and they are not arrogant.. Urdu: ہماری آیتوں پر تو وہی لوگ ایمان لاتے ہیں کہ جب اُن کو اُن سے نصیحت کی جاتی ہے تو سجدے میں گرپڑتے اور اپنے پروردگار کی تعریف کے ساتھ تسبیح کرتے ہیں اور غرور نہیں کرتے.

Quran 32:29. Arabic: قُلْ يَوْمَ ٱلْفَتْحِ لَا يَنفَعُ ٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُوٓا۟ إِيمَٰنُهُمْ وَلَا هُمْ يُنظَرُونَ. English: Say, [O Muhammad], "On the Day of Conquest the belief of those who had disbelieved will not benefit them, nor will they be reprieved.". Urdu: کہہ دو کہ فیصلے کے دن کافروں کو ان کا ایمان لانا کچھ بھی فائدہ نہ دے گا اور نہ اُن کو مہلت دی جائے گی.

q-0294.answer:
Surah As-Sajda (32) — The Prostration · 30 ayahs · Meccan

Main teachings:
• They pray the voluntary night prayer and forego sleep and resting on a comfortable bed.
• Their hearts believed in the signs of Allah, and they did as the signs of Allah dictate, i.
• Turn away from these idolators, and convey that which has been revealed to you from your Lord.
• We shall avenge Ourselves on those who do that in the strongest possible terms.

Full ayah text and tafsir are available in the sources below.

q-0295.answer:
Surah Al-Ahzaab (33) — The Clans · 73 ayahs · Medinan

Main teachings:
• O Prophet, fear Allah and do not obey the disbelievers and the hypocrites. Indeed, Allah is ever Knowing and Wise.
• And follow that which is revealed to you from your Lord. Indeed Allah is ever, with what you do, Acquainted.
• And rely upon Allah; and sufficient is Allah as Disposer of affairs.
• It is not for a believing man or a believing woman, when Allah and His Messenger have decided a matter, that they should [thereafter] have any choice about their affair. And whoever disobeys Allah and His Messenger has certainly strayed into clear error.
• Indeed, we offered the Trust to the heavens and the earth and the mountains, and they declined to bear it and feared it; but man [undertook to] bear it. Indeed, he was unjust and ignorant.

Full ayah text and tafsir are available in the sources below.

q-0298.answer:
Surah Al-Ahzaab (33) — The Clans · 73 ayahs · Medinan

Main teachings:
• O Prophet, fear Allah and do not obey the disbelievers and the hypocrites. Indeed, Allah is ever Knowing and Wise.
• And follow that which is revealed to you from your Lord. Indeed Allah is ever, with what you do, Acquainted.
• And rely upon Allah; and sufficient is Allah as Disposer of affairs.
• It is not for a believing man or a believing woman, when Allah and His Messenger have decided a matter, that they should [thereafter] have any choice about their affair. And whoever disobeys Allah and His Messenger has certainly strayed into clear error.
• Indeed, we offered the Trust to the heavens and the earth and the mountains, and they declined to bear it and feared it; but man [undertook to] bear it. Indeed, he was unjust and ignorant.

Full ayah text and tafsir are available in the sources below.

Indeed Allah is ever, with what you do, Acquainted.. Urdu: اور جو (کتاب) تم کو تمہارے پروردگار کی طرف سے وحی کی جاتی ہے اُسی کی پیروی کئے جانا۔ بےشک خدا تمہارے سب عملوں سے خبردار ہے.

Quran 33:3. Arabic: وَتَوَكَّلْ عَلَى ٱللَّهِ ۚ وَكَفَىٰ بِٱللَّهِ وَكِيلًۭا. English: And rely upon Allah; and sufficient is Allah as Disposer of affairs.. Urdu: اور خدا پر بھروسہ رکھنا۔ اور خدا ہی کارساز کافی ہے.

q-0299.answer:
Surah Saba (34) — Sheba · 54 ayahs · Meccan

Main teachings:
• Only faith and righteous deeds will bring you closer to Us.
• He gives wealth to those whom He loves and those whom He does not love, and He makes poor whom He wills and makes rich whom He wills.
• [All] praise is [due] to Allah, to whom belongs whatever is in the heavens and whatever is in the earth, and to Him belongs [all] praise in the Hereafter. And He is the Wise, the Acquainted.
• He knows what penetrates into the earth and what emerges from it and what descends from the heaven and what ascends therein. And He is the Merciful, the Forgiving.
• But those who disbelieve say, "The Hour will not come to us." Say, "Yes, by my Lord, it will surely come to you. [Allah is] the Knower of the unseen." Not absent from Him is an atom's weight within the heavens or within the earth or [what is] smaller than that or greater, except that it is in a clear register -

English: And they had already disbelieved in it before and would assault the unseen from a place far away.. Urdu: اور پہلے تو اس سے انکار کرتے رہے اور بن دیکھے دور ہی سے (ظن کے) تیر چلاتے رہے.

q-0301.answer: Scholars classify the 114 surahs by where they were first revealed: approximately **86 surahs are Meccan** (revealed before Hijrah in Makkah) and **28 are Medinan** (revealed after Hijrah in Madinah). Meccan surahs often focus on faith, tawhid, and the Hereafter; Medinan surahs often address law, community, and governance. Individual surah pages show each surah's revelation type.

English: He has sent down upon you, [O Muhammad], the Book in truth, confirming what was before it. And He revealed the Torah and the Gospel.. q-0302.answer:
Surah Saba (34) — Sheba · 54 ayahs · Meccan

Main teachings:
• Only faith and righteous deeds will bring you closer to Us.
• He gives wealth to those whom He loves and those whom He does not love, and He makes poor whom He wills and makes rich whom He wills.
• [All] praise is [due] to Allah, to whom belongs whatever is in the heavens and whatever is in the earth, and to Him belongs [all] praise in the Hereafter. And He is the Wise, the Acquainted.
• He knows what penetrates into the earth and what emerges from it and what descends from the heaven and what ascends therein. And He is the Merciful, the Forgiving.
• But those who disbelieve say, "The Hour will not come to us." Say, "Yes, by my Lord, it will surely come to you. [Allah is] the Knower of the unseen." Not absent from Him is an atom's weight within the heavens or within the earth or [what is] smaller than that or greater, except that it is in a clear register -

Full ayah text and tafsir are available in the sources below.

q-0303.answer:
Surah Faatir (35) — The Originator · 45 ayahs · Meccan

Main teachings:
• The Believer and the Disbeliever are not equal
• That He may give them a reward for what they have done, and multiply it by adding more, such as has never occurred to them.
• Remember the Bad Consequences of disbelieving in the Prophets
• If He were to punish them for all of their sins, He would destroy all the people of the earth and all that they own of livestock and crops.

Full ayah text and tafsir are available in the sources below.

q-0305.answer: Scholars classify the 114 surahs by where they were first revealed: approximately **86 surahs are Meccan** (revealed before Hijrah in Makkah) and **28 are Medinan** (revealed after Hijrah in Madinah). Meccan surahs often focus on faith, tawhid, and the Hereafter; Medinan surahs often address law, community, and governance. Individual surah pages show each surah's revelation type.

sources.snippet: Quran 3:3. Arabic: نَزَّلَ عَلَيْكَ ٱلْكِتَٰبَ بِٱلْحَقِّ مُصَدِّقًۭا لِّمَا بَيْنَ يَدَيْهِ وَأَنزَلَ ٱلتَّوْرَىٰةَ وَٱلْإِنجِيلَ. English: He has sent down upon you, [O Muhammad], the Book in truth, confirming what was before it. And He revealed the Torah and the Gospel.. Urdu: اس نے (اے محمدﷺ) تم پر سچی کتاب نازل کی جو پہلی (آسمانی) کتابوں کی تصدیق کرتی ہے اور اسی نے تورات اور انجیل نازل کی.

Quran 5:3. Arabic: حُرِّمَتْ عَلَيْكُمُ ٱلْمَيْتَةُ وَٱلدَّمُ وَلَحْمُ ٱلْخِنزِيرِ وَمَآ أُهِلَّ لِغَيْرِ ٱللَّهِ بِهِۦ وَٱلْمُنْخَنِقَةُ وَٱلْمَوْقُوذَةُ وَٱلْمُتَرَدِّيَةُ وَٱلنَّطِيحَةُ وَمَآ أَكَلَ ٱلسَّبُعُ إِلَّا مَا ذَكَّيْتُمْ وَمَا ذُبِحَ عَلَى ٱلنُّصُبِ وَأَن تَسْتَقْسِمُوا۟ بِٱلْأَزْلَٰمِ ۚ ذَٰلِكُمْ فِسْقٌ ۗ ٱلْيَوْمَ يَئِسَ ٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا۟ مِن دِينِكُمْ فَلَا تَخْشَوْهُمْ وَٱخْشَوْنِ ۚ ٱلْيَوْمَ أَكْمَلْتُ لَكُمْ دِينَكُمْ وَأَتْمَمْتُ عَلَيْكُمْ نِعْمَتِى وَرَضِيتُ لَكُمُ ٱلْإِسْلَٰمَ دِينًۭا ۚ فَمَنِ ٱضْطُرَّ فِى مَخْمَصَةٍ غَيْرَ مُتَجَانِفٍۢ لِّإِثْمٍۢ ۙ فَإِنَّ ٱللَّهَ…

Quran 17:1. Arabic: بِسْمِ ٱللَّهِ ٱلرَّحْمَٰنِ ٱلرَّحِيمِ سُبْحَٰنَ ٱلَّذِىٓ أَسْرَىٰ بِعَبْدِهِۦ لَيْلًۭا مِّنَ ٱلْمَسْجِدِ ٱلْحَرَامِ إِلَى ٱلْمَسْجِدِ ٱلْأَقْصَا ٱلَّذِى بَٰرَكْنَا حَوْلَهُۥ لِنُرِيَهُۥ مِنْ ءَايَٰتِنَآ ۚ إِنَّهُۥ هُوَ ٱلسَّمِيعُ ٱلْبَصِيرُ. English: Exalted is He who took His Servant by night from al-Masjid al-Haram to al-Masjid al-Aqsa, whose surroundings We have blessed, to show him of Our signs. Indeed, He is the Hearing, the Seeing.. Urdu: وہ (ذات) پاک ہے جو ایک رات اپنے بندے کو مسجدالحرام یعنی (خانہٴ کعبہ) سے مسجد اقصیٰ (یعنی بیت المقدس) تک جس کے گردا گرد ہم نے برک…

q-0306.answer:
Surah Faatir (35) — The Originator · 45 ayahs · Meccan

Main teachings:
• The Believer and the Disbeliever are not equal
• That He may give them a reward for what they have done, and multiply it by adding more, such as has never occurred to them.
• Remember the Bad Consequences of disbelieving in the Prophets
• If He were to punish them for all of their sins, He would destroy all the people of the earth and all that they own of livestock and crops.

Full ayah text and tafsir are available in the sources below.

sources.snippet: Quran 35:1. Arabic: بِسْمِ ٱللَّهِ ٱلرَّحْمَٰنِ ٱلرَّحِيمِ ٱلْحَمْدُ لِلَّهِ فَاطِرِ ٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتِ وَٱلْأَرْضِ جَاعِلِ ٱلْمَلَٰٓئِكَةِ رُسُلًا أُو۟لِىٓ أَجْنِحَةٍۢ مَّثْنَىٰ وَثُلَٰثَ وَرُبَٰعَ ۚ يَزِيدُ فِى ٱلْخَلْقِ مَا يَشَآءُ ۚ إِنَّ ٱللَّهَ عَلَىٰ كُلِّ شَىْءٍۢ قَدِيرٌۭ. English: [All] praise is [due] to Allah, Creator of the heavens and the earth, [who] made the angels messengers having wings, two or three or four. He increases in creation what He wills. Indeed, Allah is over all things competent.. Urdu: سب تعریف خدا ہی کو (سزاوار ہے) جو آسمانوں اور زمین کا پیدا کرنے والا (اور) فرشتوں…

Quran 35:2. Arabic: مَّا يَفْتَحِ ٱللَّهُ لِلنَّاسِ مِن رَّحْمَةٍۢ فَلَا مُمْسِكَ لَهَا ۖ وَمَا يُمْسِكْ فَلَا مُرْسِلَ لَهُۥ مِنۢ بَعْدِهِۦ ۚ وَهُوَ ٱلْعَزِيزُ ٱلْحَكِيمُ. English: Whatever Allah grants to people of mercy - none can withhold it; and whatever He withholds - none can release it thereafter. And He is the Exalted in Might, the Wise.. Urdu: خدا جو اپنی رحمت (کا دروازہ) کھول دے تو کوئی اس کو بند کرنے والا نہیں۔ اور جو بند کردے تو اس کے بعد کوئی اس کو کھولنے والا نہیں۔ اور وہ غالب حکمت والا ہے.

Quran 35:3. Arabic: يَٰٓأَيُّهَا ٱلنَّاسُ ٱذْكُرُوا۟ نِعْمَتَ ٱللَّهِ عَلَيْكُمْ ۚ هَلْ مِنْ خَٰلِقٍ غَيْرُ ٱللَّهِ يَرْزُقُكُم مِّنَ ٱلسَّمَآءِ وَٱلْأَرْضِ ۚ لَآ إِلَٰهَ إِلَّا هُوَ ۖ فَأَنَّىٰ تُؤْفَكُونَ. English: O mankind, remember the favor of Allah upon you. Is there any creator other than Allah who provides for you from the heaven and earth? There is no deity except Him, so how are you deluded?. Urdu: لوگو خدا کے جو تم پر احسانات ہیں ان کو یاد کرو۔ کیا خدا کے سوا کوئی اور خالق (اور رازق ہے) جو تم کو آسمان اور زمین سے رزق دے۔ اس کے سوا کوئی معبود نہیں پس تم کہاں بہکے پھرتے ہو؟.

Quran 35:22. Arabic: وَمَا يَسْتَوِى ٱلْأَحْيَآءُ وَلَا ٱلْأَمْوَٰتُ ۚ إِنَّ ٱللَّهَ يُسْمِعُ مَن يَشَآءُ ۖ وَمَآ أَنتَ بِمُسْمِعٍۢ مَّن فِى ٱلْقُبُورِ. English: And not equal are the living and the dead. Indeed, Allah causes to hear whom He wills, but you cannot make hear those in the graves.. Urdu: اور نہ زندے اور مردے برابر ہوسکتے ہیں۔ خدا جس کو چاہتا ہے سنا دیتا ہے۔ اور تم ان کو جو قبروں میں مدفون ہیں نہیں سنا سکتے.

Quran 35:44. Arabic: أَوَلَمْ يَسِيرُوا۟ فِى ٱلْأَرْضِ فَيَنظُرُوا۟ كَيْفَ كَانَ عَٰقِبَةُ ٱلَّذِينَ مِن قَبْلِهِمْ وَكَانُوٓا۟ أَشَدَّ مِنْهُمْ قُوَّةًۭ ۚ وَمَا كَانَ ٱللَّهُ لِيُعْجِزَهُۥ مِن شَىْءٍۢ فِى ٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتِ وَلَا فِى ٱلْأَرْضِ ۚ إِنَّهُۥ كَانَ عَلِيمًۭا قَدِيرًۭا. English: Have they not traveled through the land and observed how was the end of those before them? And they were greater than them in power. But Allah is not to be caused failure by anything in the heavens or on the earth. Indeed, He is ever Knowing and Competent.. Urdu: کیا انہوں نے زمین میں کبھی سیر نہیں کی تاکہ دیکھ…

q-0307.answer:
Surah Yaseen (36) — Yaseen · 83 ayahs · Meccan

Main teachings:
• Until a time that is known to Allah, may He be glorified and exalted.
• The like of mankind. So, He will re-create them as He created them in the first place.
• He only needs to command a thing once; it does not need to be repeated or confirmed.

Full ayah text and tafsir are available in the sources below.

sources.snippet: Quran 36:1. Arabic: بِسْمِ ٱللَّهِ ٱلرَّحْمَٰنِ ٱلرَّحِيمِ يسٓ. English: Ya, Seen.. Urdu: یٰسٓ.
Quran 36:2. Arabic: وَٱلْقُرْءَانِ ٱلْحَكِيمِ. English: By the wise Qur'an.. Urdu: قسم ہے قرآن کی جو حکمت سے بھرا ہوا ہے.
Quran 36:3. Arabic: إِنَّكَ لَمِنَ ٱلْمُرْسَلِينَ. English: Indeed you, [O Muhammad], are from among the messengers,. Urdu: اے محمدﷺ) بےشک تم پیغمبروں میں سے ہو.

Quran 36:41. Arabic: وَءَايَةٌۭ لَّهُمْ أَنَّا حَمَلْنَا ذُرِّيَّتَهُمْ فِى ٱلْفُلْكِ ٱلْمَشْحُونِ. English: And a sign for them is that We carried their forefathers in a laden ship.. Urdu: اور ایک نشانی ان کے لئے یہ ہے کہ ہم نے ان کی اولاد کو بھری ہوئی کشتی میں سوار کیا.

Quran 36:82. Arabic: إِنَّمَآ أَمْرُهُۥٓ إِذَآ أَرَادَ شَيْـًٔا أَن يَقُولَ لَهُۥ كُن فَيَكُونُ. English: His command is only when He intends a thing that He says to it, "Be," and it is.. Urdu: اس کی شان یہ ہے کہ جب وہ کسی چیز کا ارادہ کرتا ہے تو اس سے فرما دیتا ہے کہ ہوجا تو وہ ہوجاتی ہے.

q-0309.answer: Scholars classify the 114 surahs by where they were first revealed: approximately **86 surahs are Meccan** (revealed before Hijrah in Makkah) and **28 are Medinan** (revealed after Hijrah in Madinah). Meccan surahs often focus on faith, tawhid, and the Hereafter; Medinan surahs often address law, community, and governance. Individual surah pages show each surah's revelation type.

q-0311.answer:
Surah As-Saff (61) — The Ranks · 14 ayahs · Medinan

Main teachings:
• None is more unjust than he who lies about Allah and calls upon rivals and associates partners with Him, even while he is being invited to Tawhid and sincerely worshipping Him.
• We will support you with regards to the Message you have been sent with and will help you convey it.
• Whatever is in the heavens and whatever is on the earth exalts Allah, and He is the Exalted in Might, the Wise.
• O you who have believed, why do you say what you do not do?
• Great is hatred in the sight of Allah that you say what you do not do.

Full ayah text and tafsir are available in the sources below.

sources.snippet: Quran 61:1. Arabic: بِسْمِ ٱللَّهِ ٱلرَّحْمَٰنِ ٱلرَّحِيمِ سَبَّحَ لِلَّهِ مَا فِى ٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتِ وَمَا فِى ٱلْأَرْضِ ۖ وَهُوَ ٱلْعَزِيزُ ٱلْحَكِيمُ. English: Whatever is in the heavens and whatever is on the earth exalts Allah, and He is the Exalted in Might, the Wise.. Urdu: جو چیز آسمانوں میں ہے اور زمین میں ہے سب خدا کی تنزیہ کرتی ہے اور وہ غالب حکمت والا ہے.

Quran 61:2. Arabic: يَٰٓأَيُّهَا ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوا۟ لِمَ تَقُولُونَ مَا لَا تَفْعَلُونَ. English: O you who have believed, why do you say what you do not do?. Urdu: مومنو! تم ایسی باتیں کیوں کہا کرتے ہو جو کیا نہیں کرتے.

Quran 61:3. Arabic: كَبُرَ مَقْتًا عِندَ ٱللَّهِ أَن تَقُولُوا۟ مَا لَا تَفْعَلُونَ. English: Great is hatred in the sight of Allah that you say what you do not do.. Urdu: خدا اس بات سے سخت بیزار ہے کہ ایسی بات کہو جو کرو نہیں.

Quran 61:7. Arabic: وَمَنْ أَظْلَمُ مِمَّنِ ٱفْتَرَىٰ عَلَى ٱللَّهِ ٱلْكَذِبَ وَهُوَ يُدْعَىٰٓ إِلَى ٱلْإِسْلَٰمِ ۚ وَٱللَّهُ لَا يَهْدِى ٱلْقَوْمَ ٱلظَّٰلِمِينَ. English: And who is more unjust than one who invents about Allah untruth while he is being invited to Islam. And Allah does not guide the wrongdoing people.. Urdu: اور اس سے ظالم کون کہ بلایا تو جائے اسلام کی طرف اور وہ خدا پر جھوٹ بہتان باندھے۔ اور خدا ظالم لوگوں کو ہدایت نہیں دیا کرتا.

Quran 61:13. Arabic: وَأُخْرَىٰ تُحِبُّونَهَا ۖ نَصْرٌۭ مِّنَ ٱللَّهِ وَفَتْحٌۭ قَرِيبٌۭ ۗ وَبَشِّرِ ٱلْمُؤْمِنِينَ. English: And [you will obtain] another [favor] that you love - victory from Allah and an imminent conquest; and give good tidings to the believers.. Urdu: اور ایک اور چیز جس کو تم بہت چاہتے ہو (یعنی تمہیں) خدا کی طرف سے مدد (نصیب ہوگی) اور فتح عنقریب ہوگی اور مومنوں کو (اس کی) خوشخبری سنا دو.

q-0312.answer:
Surah As-Saaffaat (37) — Those drawn up in Ranks · 182 ayahs · Meccan

Main teachings:
• By those [angels] lined up in rows
• And those who drive [the clouds]
• And those who recite the message,
• Then he turned to their gods and said, "Do you not eat?
• And peace upon the messengers.

Full ayah text and tafsir are available in the sources below.

Quran 37:2. Arabic: فَٱلزَّٰجِرَٰتِ زَجْرًۭا. English: And those who drive [the clouds]. Urdu: پھر ڈانٹنے والوں کی جھڑک کر.
Quran 37:3. Arabic: فَٱلتَّٰلِيَٰتِ ذِكْرًا. English: And those who recite the message,. Urdu: پھر ذکر (یعنی قرآن) پڑھنے والوں کی (غور کرکر).

Quran 37:91. Arabic: فَرَاغَ إِلَىٰٓ ءَالِهَتِهِمْ فَقَالَ أَلَا تَأْكُلُونَ. English: Then he turned to their gods and said, "Do you not eat?. Urdu: پھر ابراہیم ان کے معبودوں کی طرف متوجہ ہوئے اور کہنے لگے کہ تم کھاتے کیوں نہیں؟.

Quran 17:1. Arabic: بِسْمِ ٱللَّهِ ٱلرَّحْمَٰنِ ٱلرَّحِيمِ سُبْحَٰنَ ٱلَّذِىٓ أَسْرَىٰ بِعَبْدِهِۦ لَيْلًۭا مِّنَ ٱلْمَسْجِدِ ٱلْحَرَامِ إِلَى ٱلْمَسْجِدِ ٱلْأَقْصَا ٱلَّذِى بَٰرَكْنَا حَوْلَهُۥ لِنُرِيَهُۥ مِنْ ءَايَٰتِنَآ ۚ إِنَّهُۥ هُوَ ٱلسَّمِيعُ ٱلْبَصِيرُ. q-0315.answer:
Surah Al-Masad (111) — The Palm Fibre · 5 ayahs · Meccan

Main teachings:
• May the hands of Abu Lahab be ruined, and ruined is he.
• His wealth will not avail him or that which he gained.
• He will [enter to] burn in a Fire of [blazing] flame
• And his wife [as well] - the carrier of firewood.
• Around her neck is a rope of [twisted] fiber.

Full ayah text and tafsir are available in the sources below.

sources.snippet: Quran 111:1. Arabic: بِسْمِ ٱللَّهِ ٱلرَّحْمَٰنِ ٱلرَّحِيمِ تَبَّتْ يَدَآ أَبِى لَهَبٍۢ وَتَبَّ. English: May the hands of Abu Lahab be ruined, and ruined is he.. Urdu: ابولہب کے ہاتھ ٹوٹیں اور وہ ہلاک ہو.
Quran 111:2. Arabic: مَآ أَغْنَىٰ عَنْهُ مَالُهُۥ وَمَا كَسَبَ. English: His wealth will not avail him or that which he gained.. Urdu: نہ تو اس کا مال ہی اس کے کچھ کام آیا اور نہ وہ جو اس نے کمایا.
Quran 111:3. Arabic: سَيَصْلَىٰ نَارًۭا ذَاتَ لَهَبٍۢ. English: He will [enter to] burn in a Fire of [blazing] flame. Urdu: وہ جلد بھڑکتی ہوئی آگ میں داخل ہو گا.
Quran 111:4. Arabic: وَٱمْرَأَتُهُۥ حَمَّالَةَ ٱلْحَطَبِ. English: And his wife [as well] - the carrier of firewood.. Urdu: اور اس کی جورو بھی جو ایندھن سر پر اٹھائے پھرتی ہے.
Quran 111:5. Arabic: فِى جِيدِهَا حَبْلٌۭ مِّن مَّسَدٍۭ. English: Around her neck is a rope of [twisted] fiber.. Urdu: اس کے گلے میں مونج کی رسّی ہو گی.

q-0316.answer:
Surah Saad (38) — The letter Saad · 88 ayahs · Meccan

Main teachings:
• There was no time to escape or run away; and Allah knows best.
• Because they are of the people of Hell.
• Sad. By the Qur'an containing reminder...
• But those who disbelieve are in pride and dissension.
• How many a generation have We destroyed before them, and they [then] called out; but it was not a time for escape.

Full ayah text and tafsir are available in the sources below.

sources.snippet: Quran 38:1. Arabic: بِسْمِ ٱللَّهِ ٱلرَّحْمَٰنِ ٱلرَّحِيمِ صٓ ۚ وَٱلْقُرْءَانِ ذِى ٱلذِّكْرِ. English: Sad. By the Qur'an containing reminder.... Urdu: ص۔ قسم ہے اس قرآن کی جو نصیحت دینے والا ہے (کہ تم حق پر ہو).
Quran 38:2. Arabic: بَلِ ٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا۟ فِى عِزَّةٍۢ وَشِقَاقٍۢ. English: But those who disbelieve are in pride and dissension.. Urdu: مگر جو لوگ کافر ہیں وہ غرور اور مخالفت میں ہیں.

Quran 38:3. Arabic: كَمْ أَهْلَكْنَا مِن قَبْلِهِم مِّن قَرْنٍۢ فَنَادَوا۟ وَّلَاتَ حِينَ مَنَاصٍۢ. English: How many a generation have We destroyed before them, and they [then] called out; but it was not a time for escape.. Urdu: ہم نے ان سے پہلے بہت سی اُمتوں کو ہلاک کردیا تو وہ (عذاب کے وقت) لگے فریاد کرنے اور وہ رہائی کا وقت نہیں تھا.

Quran 38:44. Arabic: وَخُذْ بِيَدِكَ ضِغْثًۭا فَٱضْرِب بِّهِۦ وَلَا تَحْنَثْ ۗ إِنَّا وَجَدْنَٰهُ صَابِرًۭا ۚ نِّعْمَ ٱلْعَبْدُ ۖ إِنَّهُۥٓ أَوَّابٌۭ. English: [We said], "And take in your hand a bunch [of grass] and strike with it and do not break your oath." Indeed, We found him patient, an excellent servant. Indeed, he was one repeatedly turning back [to Allah].. Urdu: اور اپنے ہاتھ میں جھاڑو لو اور اس سے مارو اور قسم نہ توڑو۔ بےشک ہم نے ان کو ثابت قدم پایا۔ بہت خوب بندے تھے بےشک وہ رجوع کرنے والے تھے.
Quran 38:87. Arabic: إِنْ هُوَ إِلَّا ذِكْرٌۭ لِّلْعَٰلَمِينَ. English: It is but a reminder to the worlds.. Urdu: یہ قرآن تو اہل عالم کے لئے نصیحت ہے.

Quran 38:3. Arabic: كَمْ أَهْلَكْنَا مِن قَبْلِهِم مِّن قَرْنٍۢ فَنَادَوا۟ وَّلَاتَ حِينَ مَنَاصٍۢ. English: How many a generation have We destroyed before them, and they [then] called out; but it was not a time for escape.. Quran 39:74. Arabic: وَقَالُوا۟ ٱلْحَمْدُ لِلَّهِ ٱلَّذِى صَدَقَنَا وَعْدَهُۥ وَأَوْرَثَنَا ٱلْأَرْضَ نَتَبَوَّأُ مِنَ ٱلْجَنَّةِ حَيْثُ نَشَآءُ ۖ فَنِعْمَ أَجْرُ ٱلْعَٰمِلِينَ. q-0321.answer: Scholars classify the 114 surahs by where they were first revealed: approximately **86 surahs are Meccan** (revealed before Hijrah in Makkah) and **28 are Medinan** (revealed after Hijrah in Madinah). Meccan surahs often focus on faith, tawhid, and the Hereafter; Medinan surahs often address law, community, and governance. Individual surah pages show each surah's revelation type.

q-0323.answer:
Surah Ghafir (40) — The Forgiver · 85 ayahs · Meccan

Main teachings:
• They will dwell therein forever, because of their great sin, which is associating others in worship with Allah.
• On the Day of Resurrection the victory will be greater and more complete.
• The revelation of the Book is from Allah, the Exalted in Might, the Knowing.
• The forgiver of sin, acceptor of repentance, severe in punishment, owner of abundance. There is no deity except Him; to Him is the destination.
• You invite me to disbelieve in Allah and associate with Him that of which I have no knowledge, and I invite you to the Exalted in Might, the Perpetual Forgiver.

q-0325.answer: Scholars classify the 114 surahs by where they were first revealed: approximately **86 surahs are Meccan** (revealed before Hijrah in Makkah) and **28 are Medinan** (revealed after Hijrah in Madinah). Meccan surahs often focus on faith, tawhid, and the Hereafter; Medinan surahs often address law, community, and governance. Individual surah pages show each surah's revelation type.

q-0330.answer:
Surah Fussilat (41) — Explained in detail · 54 ayahs · Meccan

Main teachings:
• No one accepts this advice and works according to it, except for those who can be patient in doing so, for it is difficult for people to do.
• The Qur'an and the Proofs of its Truth
• [This is] a revelation from the Entirely Merciful, the Especially Merciful -
• A Book whose verses have been detailed, an Arabic Qur'an for a people who know,
• But We will surely cause those who disbelieve to taste a severe punishment, and We will surely recompense them for the worst of what they had been doing.

Full ayah text and tafsir are available in the sources below.

q-0342.answer:
Surah Ad-Dukhaan (44) — The Smoke · 59 ayahs · Meccan

Main teachings:
• Everything that happens and is decreed by Allah and the revelation that He sends down – it all happens by His command, by His leave and with His knowledge.
• They will come to know who will be victorious and whose word will prevail in this world and in the Hereafter.
• By the clear Book,
• Indeed, We sent it down during a blessed night. Indeed, We were to warn [mankind].
• And the heaven and earth wept not for them, nor were they reprieved.

Full ayah text and tafsir are available in the sources below.

sources.snippet: Quran 44:1. Arabic: بِسْمِ ٱللَّهِ ٱلرَّحْمَٰنِ ٱلرَّحِيمِ حمٓ. English: Ha, Meem.. Urdu: حٰم.
Quran 44:2. Arabic: وَٱلْكِتَٰبِ ٱلْمُبِينِ. English: By the clear Book,. Urdu: اس کتاب روشن کی قسم.

Quran 44:3. Arabic: إِنَّآ أَنزَلْنَٰهُ فِى لَيْلَةٍۢ مُّبَٰرَكَةٍ ۚ إِنَّا كُنَّا مُنذِرِينَ. English: Indeed, We sent it down during a blessed night. Indeed, We were to warn [mankind].. Urdu: کہ ہم نے اس کو مبارک رات میں نازل فرمایا ہم تو رستہ دکھانے والے ہیں.

Quran 44:29. Arabic: فَمَا بَكَتْ عَلَيْهِمُ ٱلسَّمَآءُ وَٱلْأَرْضُ وَمَا كَانُوا۟ مُنظَرِينَ. English: And the heaven and earth wept not for them, nor were they reprieved.. Urdu: پھر ان پر نہ تو آسمان کو اور زمین کو رونا آیا اور نہ ان کو مہلت ہی دی گئی.

Quran 44:58. Arabic: فَإِنَّمَا يَسَّرْنَٰهُ بِلِسَانِكَ لَعَلَّهُمْ يَتَذَكَّرُونَ. English: And indeed, We have eased the Qur'an in your tongue that they might be reminded.. Urdu: ہم نے اس (قرآن) کو تمہاری زبان میں آسان کردیا ہے تاکہ یہ لوگ نصیحت پکڑیں.

q-0343.answer:
Surah Al-Jaathiya (45) — Crouching · 37 ayahs · Meccan

Main teachings:
• The revelation of the Book is from Allah, the Exalted in Might, the Wise.
• Indeed, within the heavens and earth are signs for the believers.
• Then We put you, [O Muhammad], on an ordained way concerning the matter [of religion]; so follow it and do not follow the inclinations of those who do not know.
• Then, to Allah belongs [all] praise - Lord of the heavens and Lord of the earth, Lord of the worlds.
• And to Him belongs [all] grandeur within the heavens and the earth, and He is the Exalted in Might, the Wise.

Full ayah text and tafsir are available in the sources below.

sources.snippet: Quran 45:1. Arabic: بِسْمِ ٱللَّهِ ٱلرَّحْمَٰنِ ٱلرَّحِيمِ حمٓ. English: Ha, Meem.. Urdu: حٰم.

Quran 45:2. Arabic: تَنزِيلُ ٱلْكِتَٰبِ مِنَ ٱللَّهِ ٱلْعَزِيزِ ٱلْحَكِيمِ. English: The revelation of the Book is from Allah, the Exalted in Might, the Wise.. Urdu: اس کتاب کا اُتارا جانا خدائے غالب (اور) دانا (کی طرف) سے ہے.

Quran 45:3. Arabic: إِنَّ فِى ٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتِ وَٱلْأَرْضِ لَءَايَٰتٍۢ لِّلْمُؤْمِنِينَ. English: Indeed, within the heavens and earth are signs for the believers.. Urdu: بےشک آسمانوں اور زمین میں ایمان والوں کے لئے (خدا کی قدرت کی) نشانیاں ہیں.

Quran 45:18. Arabic: ثُمَّ جَعَلْنَٰكَ عَلَىٰ شَرِيعَةٍۢ مِّنَ ٱلْأَمْرِ فَٱتَّبِعْهَا وَلَا تَتَّبِعْ أَهْوَآءَ ٱلَّذِينَ لَا يَعْلَمُونَ. English: Then We put you, [O Muhammad], on an ordained way concerning the matter [of religion]; so follow it and do not follow the inclinations of those who do not know.. Urdu: پھر ہم نے تم کو دین کے کھلے رستے پر (قائم) کر دیا تو اسی (رستے) پر چلے چلو اور نادانوں کی خواہشوں کے پیچھے نہ چلنا.

Quran 45:36. Arabic: فَلِلَّهِ ٱلْحَمْدُ رَبِّ ٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتِ وَرَبِّ ٱلْأَرْضِ رَبِّ ٱلْعَٰلَمِينَ. English: Then, to Allah belongs [all] praise - Lord of the heavens and Lord of the earth, Lord of the worlds.. Urdu: پس خدا ہی کو ہر طرح کی تعریف (سزاوار) ہے جو آسمانوں کا مالک اور زمین کا مالک اور تمام جہان کا پروردگار ہے.

q-0345.answer: Scholars classify the 114 surahs by where they were first revealed: approximately **86 surahs are Meccan** (revealed before Hijrah in Makkah) and **28 are Medinan** (revealed after Hijrah in Madinah). Meccan surahs often focus on faith, tawhid, and the Hereafter; Medinan surahs often address law, community, and governance. Individual surah pages show each surah's revelation type.

q-0347.answer:
Surah Al-Ahqaf (46) — The Dunes · 35 ayahs · Meccan

Main teachings:
• No one is more misguided than those who invoke idols instead of Allah, asking them for things that they cannot give – until the Day of Judgment.
• When they saw the punishment coming towards them, they thought it to be clouds full of rain.
• Evidence for Life after Death
• The disbelievers are distracted from what is intended for them.
• This is the torment that you called for saying, "Bring to us what you promise us if you should be of the truthful.

Full ayah text and tafsir are available in the sources below.

q-0349.answer: Scholars classify the 114 surahs by where they were first revealed: approximately **86 surahs are Meccan** (revealed before Hijrah in Makkah) and **28 are Medinan** (revealed after Hijrah in Madinah). Meccan surahs often focus on faith, tawhid, and the Hereafter; Medinan surahs often address law, community, and governance. Individual surah pages show each surah's revelation type.

Surah Muhammad (47) — Muhammad · 38 ayahs · Medinan

Main teachings:
• The Reward of the Disbelievers and the Believers
• He inspires them to their righteous guidance.
• Worldly Life and encouraging Spending Expressing the insignificance and worthlessness of the worldly life
• We only invalidate the deeds of the disbelievers and overlook the sins of the righteous, and amend their affairs, because those who disbelieve follow falsehood.
• At this moment. They did not understand what he said, nor did they care about it.

Full ayah text and tafsir are available in the sources below.

Quran 47:2. English: And those who believe and do righteous deeds and believe in what has been sent down upon Muhammad - and it is the truth from their Lord - He will remove from them their misdeeds and amend their condition.. Urdu: اور جو ایمان لائے اور نیک عمل کرتے رہے اور جو (کتاب) محمدﷺ پر نازل ہوئی اسے مانتے رہے اور وہ ان کے پروردگار کی طرف سے برحق ہے ان سے ان کے گناہ دور کردیئے اور ان کی حالت سنوار د…

Quran 47:3. Arabic: ذَٰلِكَ بِأَنَّ ٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا۟ ٱتَّبَعُوا۟ ٱلْبَٰطِلَ وَأَنَّ ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوا۟ ٱتَّبَعُوا۟ ٱلْحَقَّ مِن رَّبِّهِمْ ۚ كَذَٰلِكَ يَضْرِبُ ٱللَّهُ لِلنَّاسِ أَمْثَٰلَهُمْ. English: That is because those who disbelieve follow falsehood, and those who believe follow the truth from their Lord. Thus does Allah present to the people their comparisons.. Urdu: یہ (حبط اعمال اور اصلاح حال) اس لئے ہے کہ جن لوگوں نے کفر کیا انہوں نے جھوٹی بات کی پیروی کی اور جو ایمان لائے وہ اپنے پروردگار کی طرف سے (دین) حق کے پیچھے چلے۔ اسی طرح خدا لوگوں سے ان کے حالات بیان فرماتا ہے.

Quran 47:19. Arabic: فَٱعْلَمْ أَنَّهُۥ لَآ إِلَٰهَ إِلَّا ٱللَّهُ وَٱسْتَغْفِرْ لِذَنۢبِكَ وَلِلْمُؤْمِنِينَ وَٱلْمُؤْمِنَٰتِ ۗ وَٱللَّهُ يَعْلَمُ مُتَقَلَّبَكُمْ وَمَثْوَىٰكُمْ. English: So know, [O Muhammad], that there is no deity except Allah and ask forgiveness for your sin and for the believing men and believing women. Quran 47:37. Arabic: إِن يَسْـَٔلْكُمُوهَا فَيُحْفِكُمْ تَبْخَلُوا۟ وَيُخْرِجْ أَضْغَٰنَكُمْ. English: If He should ask you for them and press you, you would withhold, and He would expose your unwillingness.. Urdu: اگر وہ تم سے مال طلب کرے اور تمہیں تنگ کرے تو تم بخل کرنے لگو اور وہ (بخل) تمہاری بدنیتی ظاہر کرکے رہے.

q-0353.answer: Scholars classify the 114 surahs by where they were first revealed: approximately **86 surahs are Meccan** (revealed before Hijrah in Makkah) and **28 are Medinan** (revealed after Hijrah in Madinah). Meccan surahs often focus on faith, tawhid, and the Hereafter; Medinan surahs often address law, community, and governance. Individual surah pages show each surah's revelation type.

q-0354.answer:
Surah Muhammad (47) — Muhammad · 38 ayahs · Medinan

Main teachings:
• The Reward of the Disbelievers and the Believers
• He inspires them to their righteous guidance.
• Worldly Life and encouraging Spending Expressing the insignificance and worthlessness of the worldly life
• We only invalidate the deeds of the disbelievers and overlook the sins of the righteous, and amend their affairs, because those who disbelieve follow falsehood.
• At this moment. They did not understand what he said, nor did they care about it.

Full ayah text and tafsir are available in the sources below.

q-0355.answer:
Surah Al-Fath (48) — The Victory · 29 ayahs · Medinan

Main teachings:
• Indeed, We have given you, [O Muhammad], a clear conquest
• That Allah may forgive for you what preceded of your sin and what will follow and complete His favor upon you and guide you to a straight path
• And [that] Allah may aid you with a mighty victory.
• And to Allah belongs the dominion of the heavens and the earth. He forgives whom He wills and punishes whom He wills. And ever is Allah Forgiving and Merciful.
• It is He who sent His Messenger with guidance and the religion of truth to manifest it over all religion. And sufficient is Allah as Witness.

Full ayah text and tafsir are available in the sources below.

sources.snippet: Quran 48:1. Arabic: بِسْمِ ٱللَّهِ ٱلرَّحْمَٰنِ ٱلرَّحِيمِ إِنَّا فَتَحْنَا لَكَ فَتْحًۭا مُّبِينًۭا. English: Indeed, We have given you, [O Muhammad], a clear conquest. Urdu: (اے محمدﷺ) ہم نے تم کو فتح دی۔ فتح بھی صریح وصاف.

Quran 48:2. Arabic: لِّيَغْفِرَ لَكَ ٱللَّهُ مَا تَقَدَّمَ مِن ذَنۢبِكَ وَمَا تَأَخَّرَ وَيُتِمَّ نِعْمَتَهُۥ عَلَيْكَ وَيَهْدِيَكَ صِرَٰطًۭا مُّسْتَقِيمًۭا. English: That Allah may forgive for you what preceded of your sin and what will follow and complete His favor upon you and guide you to a straight path. Urdu: تاکہ خدا تمہارے اگلے اور پچھلے گناہ بخش دے اور تم پر اپنی نعمت پوری کردے اور تمہیں سیدھے رستے چلائے.
Quran 48:3. Arabic: وَيَنصُرَكَ ٱللَّهُ نَصْرًا عَزِيزًا. English: And [that] Allah may aid you with a mighty victory.. Urdu: اور خدا تمہاری زبردست مدد کرے.

Quran 48:14. Arabic: وَلِلَّهِ مُلْكُ ٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتِ وَٱلْأَرْضِ ۚ يَغْفِرُ لِمَن يَشَآءُ وَيُعَذِّبُ مَن يَشَآءُ ۚ وَكَانَ ٱللَّهُ غَفُورًۭا رَّحِيمًۭا. English: And to Allah belongs the dominion of the heavens and the earth. He forgives whom He wills and punishes whom He wills. And ever is Allah Forgiving and Merciful.. Urdu: اور آسمانوں اور زمین کی بادشاہی خدا ہی کی ہے۔ وہ جسے چاہے بخشے اور جسے چاہے سزا دے۔ اور خدا بخشنے والا مہربان ہے.

Quran 48:28. Arabic: هُوَ ٱلَّذِىٓ أَرْسَلَ رَسُولَهُۥ بِٱلْهُدَىٰ وَدِينِ ٱلْحَقِّ لِيُظْهِرَهُۥ عَلَى ٱلدِّينِ كُلِّهِۦ ۚ وَكَفَىٰ بِٱللَّهِ شَهِيدًۭا. English: It is He who sent His Messenger with guidance and the religion of truth to manifest it over all religion. And sufficient is Allah as Witness.. Urdu: وہی تو ہے جس نے اپنے پیغمبر کو ہدایت (کی کتاب) اور دین حق دے کر بھیجا تاکہ اس کو تمام دینوں پر غالب کرے۔ اور حق ظاہر کرنے کے لئے خدا ہی کافی ہے.

q-0357.answer: Scholars classify the 114 surahs by where they were first revealed: approximately **86 surahs are Meccan** (revealed before Hijrah in Makkah) and **28 are Medinan** (revealed after Hijrah in Madinah). Meccan surahs often focus on faith, tawhid, and the Hereafter; Medinan surahs often address law, community, and governance. Individual surah pages show each surah's revelation type.

q-0358.answer:
Surah Al-Fath (48) — The Victory · 29 ayahs · Medinan

Main teachings:
• Indeed, We have given you, [O Muhammad], a clear conquest
• That Allah may forgive for you what preceded of your sin and what will follow and complete His favor upon you and guide you to a straight path
• And [that] Allah may aid you with a mighty victory.
• And to Allah belongs the dominion of the heavens and the earth. He forgives whom He wills and punishes whom He wills. And ever is Allah Forgiving and Merciful.
• It is He who sent His Messenger with guidance and the religion of truth to manifest it over all religion. And sufficient is Allah as Witness.

Full ayah text and tafsir are available in the sources below.

q-0359.answer:
Surah Al-Hujuraat (49) — The Inner Apartments · 18 ayahs · Medinan

Main teachings:
• Do not rush in making decisions before him, rather, follow his lead in all matters.
• O you who have believed, do not put [yourselves] before Allah and His Messenger but fear Allah. Indeed, Allah is Hearing and Knowing.
• O you who have believed, do not raise your voices above the voice of the Prophet or be loud to him in speech like the loudness of some of you to others, lest your deeds become worthless while you perceive not.
• Indeed, those who lower their voices before the Messenger of Allah - they are the ones whose hearts Allah has tested for righteousness. For them is forgiveness and great reward.
• And if two factions among the believers should fight, then make settlement between the two. But if one of them oppresses the other, then fight against the one that oppresses until it returns to the ordinance of Allah. And if it returns, then make settlement between them in justice and act justly. Indeed, Allah loves those who act justly.

Full ayah text and tafsir are available in the sources below.

q-0362.answer:
Surah Al-Hujuraat (49) — The Inner Apartments · 18 ayahs · Medinan

Main teachings:
• Do not rush in making decisions before him, rather, follow his lead in all matters.
• O you who have believed, do not put [yourselves] before Allah and His Messenger but fear Allah. Indeed, Allah is Hearing and Knowing.
• O you who have believed, do not raise your voices above the voice of the Prophet or be loud to him in speech like the loudness of some of you to others, lest your deeds become worthless while you perceive not.
• Indeed, those who lower their voices before the Messenger of Allah - they are the ones whose hearts Allah has tested for righteousness. For them is forgiveness and great reward.
• And if two factions among the believers should fight, then make settlement between the two. But if one of them oppresses the other, then fight against the one that oppresses until it returns to the ordinance of Allah. And if it returns, then make settlement between them in justice and act justly. Indeed, Allah loves those who act justly.

Full ayah text and tafsir are available in the sources below.

q-0363.answer:
Surah Al-Ahqaf (46) — The Dunes · 35 ayahs · Meccan

Main teachings:
• No one is more misguided than those who invoke idols instead of Allah, asking them for things that they cannot give – until the Day of Judgment.
• When they saw the punishment coming towards them, they thought it to be clouds full of rain.
• Evidence for Life after Death
• The disbelievers are distracted from what is intended for them.
• This is the torment that you called for saying, "Bring to us what you promise us if you should be of the truthful.

q-0364.answer:
Surah Qaaf (50) — The letter Qaaf · 45 ayahs · Meccan

Main teachings:
• This is not strange, for Allah chooses Messengers from angels and humans.
• An angel to drive him to the gathering place and an angel to bear witness against him with regards to his deeds.
• They will reside in Paradise forever and will never die, neither be transferred from it nor wish to be transferred from it.

Full ayah text and tafsir are available in the sources below.

q-0366.answer:
Surah Qaaf (50) — The letter Qaaf · 45 ayahs · Meccan

Main teachings:
• This is not strange, for Allah chooses Messengers from angels and humans.
• An angel to drive him to the gathering place and an angel to bear witness against him with regards to his deeds.
• They will reside in Paradise forever and will never die, neither be transferred from it nor wish to be transferred from it.

Full ayah text and tafsir are available in the sources below.

sources.snippet: Quran 50:1. Arabic: بِسْمِ ٱللَّهِ ٱلرَّحْمَٰنِ ٱلرَّحِيمِ قٓ ۚ وَٱلْقُرْءَانِ ٱلْمَجِيدِ. English: Qaf. By the honored Qur'an.... Urdu: قٓ۔ قرآن مجید کی قسم (کہ محمد پیغمبر خدا ہیں).

Quran 50:2. Arabic: بَلْ عَجِبُوٓا۟ أَن جَآءَهُم مُّنذِرٌۭ مِّنْهُمْ فَقَالَ ٱلْكَٰفِرُونَ هَٰذَا شَىْءٌ عَجِيبٌ. English: But they wonder that there has come to them a warner from among themselves, and the disbelievers say, "This is an amazing thing.. Urdu: لیکن ان لوگوں نے تعجب کیا کہ انہی میں سے ایک ہدایت کرنے والا ان کے پاس آیا تو کافر کہنے لگے کہ یہ بات تو (بڑی) عجیب ہے.

Quran 50:3. Arabic: أَءِذَا مِتْنَا وَكُنَّا تُرَابًۭا ۖ ذَٰلِكَ رَجْعٌۢ بَعِيدٌۭ. English: When we have died and have become dust, [we will return to life]? That is a distant return.". Urdu: بھلا جب ہم مر گئے اور مٹی ہوگئے (تو پھر زندہ ہوں گے؟) یہ زندہ ہونا (عقل سے) بعید ہے.

Quran 50:22. Arabic: لَّقَدْ كُنتَ فِى غَفْلَةٍۢ مِّنْ هَٰذَا فَكَشَفْنَا عَنكَ غِطَآءَكَ فَبَصَرُكَ ٱلْيَوْمَ حَدِيدٌۭ. English: [It will be said], "You were certainly in unmindfulness of this, and We have removed from you your cover, so your sight, this Day, is sharp.". Urdu: (یہ وہ دن ہے کہ) اس سے تو غافل ہو رہا تھا۔ اب ہم نے تجھ پر سے پردہ اُٹھا دیا۔ تو آج تیری نگاہ تیز ہے.

Quran 50:44. Arabic: يَوْمَ تَشَقَّقُ ٱلْأَرْضُ عَنْهُمْ سِرَاعًۭا ۚ ذَٰلِكَ حَشْرٌ عَلَيْنَا يَسِيرٌۭ. English: On the Day the earth breaks away from them [and they emerge] rapidly; that is a gathering easy for Us.. Urdu: اس دن زمین ان پر سے پھٹ جائے گی اور وہ جھٹ پٹ نکل کھڑے ہوں گے۔ یہ جمع کرنا ہمیں آسان ہے.

q-0367.answer:
Surah Adh-Dhaariyat (51) — The Winnowing Winds · 60 ayahs · Meccan

Main teachings:
• She was glad that the people of Lut would be destroyed on account of their rebellion and transgression against Allah, the Exalted.
• Fir'awn was a denying sinner and a stubborn disbeliever worthy of blame.
• The Day of Resurrection. This is the end of the Tafsir of Surat Adh-Dhariyat; all praise is due to Allah and all the favors come from Him Alone.
• She struck herself upon her forehead, according to Mujahid and Ibn Sabit.
• I, Allah, only created them so that I order them to worship Me, not that I need them.

Full ayah text and tafsir are available in the sources below.

sources.snippet: Quran 51:1. Arabic: بِسْمِ ٱللَّهِ ٱلرَّحْمَٰنِ ٱلرَّحِيمِ وَٱلذَّٰرِيَٰتِ ذَرْوًۭا. English: By those [winds] scattering [dust] dispersing. Urdu: بکھیرنے والیوں کی قسم جو اُڑا کر بکھیر دیتی ہیں.
Quran 51:2. Arabic: فَٱلْحَٰمِلَٰتِ وِقْرًۭا. English: And those [clouds] carrying a load [of water]. Urdu: پھر (پانی کا) بوجھ اٹھاتی ہیں.
Quran 51:3. Arabic: فَٱلْجَٰرِيَٰتِ يُسْرًۭا. English: And those [ships] sailing with ease. Urdu: پھر آہستہ آہستہ چلتی ہیں.

Quran 51:30. Arabic: قَالُوا۟ كَذَٰلِكِ قَالَ رَبُّكِ ۖ إِنَّهُۥ هُوَ ٱلْحَكِيمُ ٱلْعَلِيمُ. English: They said, "Thus has said your Lord; indeed, He is the Wise, the Knowing.". Urdu: (انہوں نے) کہا (ہاں) تمہارے پروردگار نے یوں ہی فرمایا ہے۔ وہ بےشک صاحبِ حکمت (اور) خبردار ہے.

Quran 51:59. Arabic: فَإِنَّ لِلَّذِينَ ظَلَمُوا۟ ذَنُوبًۭا مِّثْلَ ذَنُوبِ أَصْحَٰبِهِمْ فَلَا يَسْتَعْجِلُونِ. English: And indeed, for those who have wronged is a portion [of punishment] like the portion of their predecessors, so let them not impatiently urge Me.. Urdu: کچھ شک نہیں کہ ان ظالموں کے لئے بھی (عذاب کی) نوبت مقرر ہے جس طرح ان کے ساتھیوں کی نوبت تھی تو ان کو مجھ سے (عذاب) جلدی نہیں طلب کرنا چاہیئے.

q-0369.answer: Scholars classify the 114 surahs by where they were first revealed: approximately **86 surahs are Meccan** (revealed before Hijrah in Makkah) and **28 are Medinan** (revealed after Hijrah in Madinah). Meccan surahs often focus on faith, tawhid, and the Hereafter; Medinan surahs often address law, community, and governance. Individual surah pages show each surah's revelation type.

q-0371.answer:
Surah At-Tur (52) — The Mount · 49 ayahs · Meccan

Main teachings:
• When they drink, they do not say any idle, vain words or utter dirty, sinful speech like the drunken people in this life do.
• On them as punishment, they would not believe it is coming their way, saying that, these are layers of clouds on top of each other.
• We will torment them in the life of the world and test them with various hardships, so that they might go back and repent.

Full ayah text and tafsir are available in the sources below.

sources.snippet: Quran 52:1. Arabic: بِسْمِ ٱللَّهِ ٱلرَّحْمَٰنِ ٱلرَّحِيمِ وَٱلطُّورِ. English: By the mount. Urdu: (کوہ) طور کی قسم.
Quran 52:2. Arabic: وَكِتَٰبٍۢ مَّسْطُورٍۢ. English: And [by] a Book inscribed. Urdu: اور کتاب کی جو لکھی ہوئی ہے.
Quran 52:3. Arabic: فِى رَقٍّۢ مَّنشُورٍۢ. English: In parchment spread open. Urdu: کشادہ اوراق میں.

Quran 52:24. Arabic: ۞ وَيَطُوفُ عَلَيْهِمْ غِلْمَانٌۭ لَّهُمْ كَأَنَّهُمْ لُؤْلُؤٌۭ مَّكْنُونٌۭ. English: There will circulate among them [servant] boys [especially] for them, as if they were pearls well-protected.. Quran 53:31. Arabic: وَلِلَّهِ مَا فِى ٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتِ وَمَا فِى ٱلْأَرْضِ لِيَجْزِىَ ٱلَّذِينَ أَسَٰٓـُٔوا۟ بِمَا عَمِلُوا۟ وَيَجْزِىَ ٱلَّذِينَ أَحْسَنُوا۟ بِٱلْحُسْنَى. English: And to Allah belongs whatever is in the heavens and whatever is in the earth - that He may recompense those who do evil with [the penalty of] what they have done and recompense those who do good with the best [reward] -. Urdu: اور جو کچھ آسمانوں میں ہے اور جو کچھ زمین میں ہے سب خدا ہی کا ہے (اور اس نے خلقت کو) اس لئے (پیدا کیا ہے) کہ جن لوگوں نے برے کام کئے ان کو ان کے اعمال کا (برا) بدلا دے اور جنہوں نے نیکیاں کیں ا…
Quran 53:61. Arabic: وَأَنتُمْ سَٰمِدُونَ. English: While you are proudly sporting?. Urdu: اور تم غفلت میں پڑ رہے ہو.

• Just as they were consumed in doubt, suspicion and hesitation, they ended up in the Fire.

sources.snippet: Quran 54:1. Arabic: بِسْمِ ٱللَّهِ ٱلرَّحْمَٰنِ ٱلرَّحِيمِ ٱقْتَرَبَتِ ٱلسَّاعَةُ وَٱنشَقَّ ٱلْقَمَرُ. English: The Hour has come near, and the moon has split [in two].. Urdu: قیامت قریب آ پہنچی اور چاند شق ہوگیا.

Quran 54:2. Arabic: وَإِن يَرَوْا۟ ءَايَةًۭ يُعْرِضُوا۟ وَيَقُولُوا۟ سِحْرٌۭ مُّسْتَمِرٌّۭ. English: And if they see a miracle, they turn away and say, "Passing magic.". Urdu: اور اگر (کافر) کوئی نشانی دیکھتے ہیں تو منہ پھیر لیتے ہیں اور کہتے ہیں کہ یہ ایک ہمیشہ کا جادو ہے.

Quran 54:3. Arabic: وَكَذَّبُوا۟ وَٱتَّبَعُوٓا۟ أَهْوَآءَهُمْ ۚ وَكُلُّ أَمْرٍۢ مُّسْتَقِرٌّۭ. English: And they denied and followed their inclinations. But for every matter is a [time of] settlement.. Urdu: اور انہوں نے جھٹلایا اور اپنی خواہشوں کی پیروی کی اور ہر کام کا وقت مقرر ہے.

Quran 54:27. Arabic: إِنَّا مُرْسِلُوا۟ ٱلنَّاقَةِ فِتْنَةًۭ لَّهُمْ فَٱرْتَقِبْهُمْ وَٱصْطَبِرْ. English: Indeed, We are sending the she-camel as trial for them, so watch them and be patient.. Urdu: (اے صالح) ہم ان کی آزمائش کے لئے اونٹنی بھیجنے والے ہیں تو تم ان کو دیکھتے رہو اور صبر کرو.
Quran 54:54. Arabic: إِنَّ ٱلْمُتَّقِينَ فِى جَنَّٰتٍۢ وَنَهَرٍۢ. English: Indeed, the righteous will be among gardens and rivers,. Urdu: جو پرہیزگار ہیں وہ باغوں اور نہروں میں ہوں گے.

sources.snippet: Quran 3:3. Arabic: نَزَّلَ عَلَيْكَ ٱلْكِتَٰبَ بِٱلْحَقِّ مُصَدِّقًۭا لِّمَا بَيْنَ يَدَيْهِ وَأَنزَلَ ٱلتَّوْرَىٰةَ وَٱلْإِنجِيلَ. English: He has sent down upon you, [O Muhammad], the Book in truth, confirming what was before it. And He revealed the Torah and the Gospel.. Urdu: اس نے (اے محمدﷺ) تم پر سچی کتاب نازل کی جو پہلی (آسمانی) کتابوں کی تصدیق کرتی ہے اور اسی نے تورات اور انجیل نازل کی.

Quran 5:3. Arabic: حُرِّمَتْ عَلَيْكُمُ ٱلْمَيْتَةُ وَٱلدَّمُ وَلَحْمُ ٱلْخِنزِيرِ وَمَآ أُهِلَّ لِغَيْرِ ٱللَّهِ بِهِۦ وَٱلْمُنْخَنِقَةُ وَٱلْمَوْقُوذَةُ وَٱلْمُتَرَدِّيَةُ وَٱلنَّطِيحَةُ وَمَآ أَكَلَ ٱلسَّبُعُ إِلَّا مَا ذَكَّيْتُمْ وَمَا ذُبِحَ عَلَى ٱلنُّصُبِ وَأَن تَسْتَقْسِمُوا۟ بِٱلْأَزْلَٰمِ ۚ ذَٰلِكُمْ فِسْقٌ ۗ ٱلْيَوْمَ يَئِسَ ٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا۟ مِن دِينِكُمْ فَلَا تَخْشَوْهُمْ وَٱخْشَوْنِ ۚ ٱلْيَوْمَ أَكْمَلْتُ لَكُمْ دِينَكُمْ وَأَتْمَمْتُ عَلَيْكُمْ نِعْمَتِى وَرَضِيتُ لَكُمُ ٱلْإِسْلَٰمَ دِينًۭا ۚ فَمَنِ ٱضْطُرَّ فِى مَخْمَصَةٍ غَيْرَ مُتَجَانِفٍۢ لِّإِثْمٍۢ ۙ فَإِنَّ ٱللَّهَ…

Quran 17:1. Arabic: بِسْمِ ٱللَّهِ ٱلرَّحْمَٰنِ ٱلرَّحِيمِ سُبْحَٰنَ ٱلَّذِىٓ أَسْرَىٰ بِعَبْدِهِۦ لَيْلًۭا مِّنَ ٱلْمَسْجِدِ ٱلْحَرَامِ إِلَى ٱلْمَسْجِدِ ٱلْأَقْصَا ٱلَّذِى بَٰرَكْنَا حَوْلَهُۥ لِنُرِيَهُۥ مِنْ ءَايَٰتِنَآ ۚ إِنَّهُۥ هُوَ ٱلسَّمِيعُ ٱلْبَصِيرُ. English: Exalted is He who took His Servant by night from al-Masjid al-Haram to al-Masjid al-Aqsa, whose surroundings We have blessed, to show him of Our signs. Indeed, He is the Hearing, the Seeing.. Urdu: وہ (ذات) پاک ہے جو ایک رات اپنے بندے کو مسجدالحرام یعنی (خانہٴ کعبہ) سے مسجد اقصیٰ (یعنی بیت المقدس) تک جس کے گردا گرد ہم نے برک…

q-0383.answer:
Surah Al-Insaan (76) — Man · 31 ayahs · Medinan

Main teachings:
• We gave him the faculties of hearing and sight so that he would be able to use them for obedience and disobedience.
• Vessels of Silver and Drinking Cups
• When We wish, We will resurrect them on the Day of Judgement and change them, repeating their creation in a new form.
• Mixed. The words Mashaj and Mashij mean something that is mixed together.
• The Ginger Drink and the Drink of Salsabil

Full ayah text and tafsir are available in the sources below.

sources.snippet: Quran 76:1. Arabic: بِسْمِ ٱللَّهِ ٱلرَّحْمَٰنِ ٱلرَّحِيمِ هَلْ أَتَىٰ عَلَى ٱلْإِنسَٰنِ حِينٌۭ مِّنَ ٱلدَّهْرِ لَمْ يَكُن شَيْـًۭٔا مَّذْكُورًا. English: Has there [not] come upon man a period of time when he was not a thing [even] mentioned?. Urdu: بےشک انسان پر زمانے میں ایک ایسا وقت بھی آچکا ہے کہ وہ کوئی چیز قابل ذکر نہ تھی.

Quran 76:2. Arabic: إِنَّا خَلَقْنَا ٱلْإِنسَٰنَ مِن نُّطْفَةٍ أَمْشَاجٍۢ نَّبْتَلِيهِ فَجَعَلْنَٰهُ سَمِيعًۢا بَصِيرًا. English: Indeed, We created man from a sperm-drop mixture that We may try him; and We made him hearing and seeing.. Urdu: ہم نے انسان کو نطفہٴ مخلوط سے پیدا کیا تاکہ اسے آزمائیں تو ہم نے اس کو سنتا دیکھتا بنایا.

Quran 76:3. Arabic: إِنَّا هَدَيْنَٰهُ ٱلسَّبِيلَ إِمَّا شَاكِرًۭا وَإِمَّا كَفُورًا. English: Indeed, We guided him to the way, be he grateful or be he ungrateful.. Urdu: (اور) اسے رستہ بھی دکھا دیا۔ (اب) وہ خواہ شکرگزار ہو خواہ ناشکرا.

Quran 76:15. Arabic: وَيُطَافُ عَلَيْهِم بِـَٔانِيَةٍۢ مِّن فِضَّةٍۢ وَأَكْوَابٍۢ كَانَتْ قَوَارِيرَا۠. English: And there will be circulated among them vessels of silver and cups having been [created] clear [as glass],. Urdu: خدام) چاندی کے باسن لئے ہوئے ان کے اردگرد پھریں گے اور شیشے کے (نہایت شفاف) گلاس.

Quran 76:30. Arabic: وَمَا تَشَآءُونَ إِلَّآ أَن يَشَآءَ ٱللَّهُ ۚ إِنَّ ٱللَّهَ كَانَ عَلِيمًا حَكِيمًۭا. English: And you do not will except that Allah wills. Indeed, Allah is ever Knowing and Wise.. Urdu: اور تم کچھ بھی نہیں چاہ سکتے مگر جو خدا کو منظور ہو۔ بےشک خدا جاننے والا حکمت والا ہے.

q-0384.answer:
Surah Ar-Rahmaan (55) — The Beneficent · 78 ayahs · Medinan

Main teachings:
• O mankind and Jinn, which of the favors that Allah has given to you do you deny?" Mujahid and others said this, and it is apparent when one reads what comes after it.
• This is the Fire that you used to deny existed that it; now you see it before your eyes!' While being chastised, criticized, disgraced and belittled, this will be said to the disbelievers.
• There are various types of good and delightful things in these two gardens in Paradise, according to Qatadah.
• None of Your favors do we deny.
• The angels of punishment will bend their heads down to their feet and throw them like this into the Hellfire.

Full ayah text and tafsir are available in the sources below.

sources.snippet: Quran 55:1. Arabic: بِسْمِ ٱللَّهِ ٱلرَّحْمَٰنِ ٱلرَّحِيمِ ٱلرَّحْمَٰنُ. English: The Most Merciful. Urdu: (خدا جو) نہایت مہربان.
Quran 55:2. Arabic: عَلَّمَ ٱلْقُرْءَانَ. English: Taught the Qur'an,. Urdu: اسی نے قرآن کی تعلیم فرمائی.
Quran 55:3. Arabic: خَلَقَ ٱلْإِنسَٰنَ. English: Created man,. Urdu: اسی نے انسان کو پیدا کیا.

Quran 55:39. Arabic: فَيَوْمَئِذٍۢ لَّا يُسْـَٔلُ عَن ذَنۢبِهِۦٓ إِنسٌۭ وَلَا جَآنٌّۭ. English: Then on that Day none will be asked about his sin among men or jinn.. Urdu: اس روز نہ تو کسی انسان سے اس کے گناہوں کے بارے میں پرسش کی جائے گی اور نہ کسی جن سے.
Quran 55:77. Arabic: فَبِأَىِّ ءَالَآءِ رَبِّكُمَا تُكَذِّبَانِ. English: So which of the favors of your Lord would you deny?. Urdu: تو تم اپنے پروردگار کی کون کون سی نعمت کو جھٹلاؤ گے؟.

q-0386.answer:
Surah Ar-Rahmaan (55) — The Beneficent · 78 ayahs · Medinan

Main teachings:
• O mankind and Jinn, which of the favors that Allah has given to you do you deny?" Mujahid and others said this, and it is apparent when one reads what comes after it.
• This is the Fire that you used to deny existed that it; now you see it before your eyes!' While being chastised, criticized, disgraced and belittled, this will be said to the disbelievers.
• There are various types of good and delightful things in these two gardens in Paradise, according to Qatadah.
• None of Your favors do we deny.
• The angels of punishment will bend their heads down to their feet and throw them like this into the Hellfire.

Full ayah text and tafsir are available in the sources below.

sources.snippet: Quran 55:1. Arabic: بِسْمِ ٱللَّهِ ٱلرَّحْمَٰنِ ٱلرَّحِيمِ ٱلرَّحْمَٰنُ. English: The Most Merciful. Urdu: (خدا جو) نہایت مہربان.
Quran 55:2. Arabic: عَلَّمَ ٱلْقُرْءَانَ. English: Taught the Qur'an,. Urdu: اسی نے قرآن کی تعلیم فرمائی.
Quran 55:3. Arabic: خَلَقَ ٱلْإِنسَٰنَ. English: Created man,. Urdu: اسی نے انسان کو پیدا کیا.

Quran 55:39. Arabic: فَيَوْمَئِذٍۢ لَّا يُسْـَٔلُ عَن ذَنۢبِهِۦٓ إِنسٌۭ وَلَا جَآنٌّۭ. English: Then on that Day none will be asked about his sin among men or jinn.. Urdu: اس روز نہ تو کسی انسان سے اس کے گناہوں کے بارے میں پرسش کی جائے گی اور نہ کسی جن سے.
Quran 55:77. Arabic: فَبِأَىِّ ءَالَآءِ رَبِّكُمَا تُكَذِّبَانِ. English: So which of the favors of your Lord would you deny?. Urdu: تو تم اپنے پروردگار کی کون کون سی نعمت کو جھٹلاؤ گے؟.

q-0387.answer:
Surah Al-Waaqia (56) — The Inevitable · 96 ayahs · Meccan

Main teachings:
• Relentlessly pulverized. This was said by Ibn 'Abbas, Mujahid, 'Ikrimah and Qatadah and others.
• We caused the seeds to grow with Our compassion and mercy and left them intact inside the earth as mercy for you.
• The angels will deliver the good news to them by saying, "Peace be upon you," i.
• It is shaken and moved violently over all of its surface and through its depths.

Full ayah text and tafsir are available in the sources below.

sources.snippet: Quran 56:1. Arabic: بِسْمِ ٱللَّهِ ٱلرَّحْمَٰنِ ٱلرَّحِيمِ إِذَا وَقَعَتِ ٱلْوَاقِعَةُ. English: When the Occurrence occurs,. Urdu: جب واقع ہونے والی واقع ہوجائے.
Quran 56:2. Arabic: لَيْسَ لِوَقْعَتِهَا كَاذِبَةٌ. English: There is, at its occurrence, no denial.. Urdu: اس کے واقع ہونے میں کچھ جھوٹ نہیں.
Quran 56:3. Arabic: خَافِضَةٌۭ رَّافِعَةٌ. English: It will bring down [some] and raise up [others].. Urdu: کسی کو پست کرے کسی کو بلند.
Quran 56:48. Arabic: أَوَءَابَآؤُنَا ٱلْأَوَّلُونَ. English: And our forefathers [as well]?". Urdu: اور کیا ہمارے باپ دادا کو بھی؟.
Quran 56:95. Arabic: إِنَّ هَٰذَا لَهُوَ حَقُّ ٱلْيَقِينِ. English: Indeed, this is the true certainty,. Urdu: یہ (داخل کیا جانا یقیناً صحیح یعنی) حق الیقین ہے.

q-0389.answer: Scholars classify the 114 surahs by where they were first revealed: approximately **86 surahs are Meccan** (revealed before Hijrah in Makkah) and **28 are Medinan** (revealed after Hijrah in Madinah). Meccan surahs often focus on faith, tawhid, and the Hereafter; Medinan surahs often address law, community, and governance. Individual surah pages show each surah's revelation type.

Surah Al-Hadid (57) — The Iron · 29 ayahs · Medinan

Main teachings:
• The Hellfire, according to Qatadah, Ibn Zayd and others.
• They give in charity with a good heart seeking the pleasure of Allah.
• It is the worthy shelter for you rather than any other residence, because of your disbelief and doubt, and how evil is the Fire for Final Destination.

Full ayah text and tafsir are available in the sources below.

sources.snippet: Quran 57:1. Arabic: بِسْمِ ٱللَّهِ ٱلرَّحْمَٰنِ ٱلرَّحِيمِ سَبَّحَ لِلَّهِ مَا فِى ٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتِ وَٱلْأَرْضِ ۖ وَهُوَ ٱلْعَزِيزُ ٱلْحَكِيمُ. English: Whatever is in the heavens and earth exalts Allah, and He is the Exalted in Might, the Wise.. Urdu: جو مخلوق آسمانوں اور زمین میں ہے خدا کی تسبیح کرتی ہے۔ اور وہ غالب (اور) حکمت والا ہے.

Quran 57:2. Arabic: لَهُۥ مُلْكُ ٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتِ وَٱلْأَرْضِ ۖ يُحْىِۦ وَيُمِيتُ ۖ وَهُوَ عَلَىٰ كُلِّ شَىْءٍۢ قَدِيرٌ. English: His is the dominion of the heavens and earth. He gives life and causes death, and He is over all things competent.. Urdu: آسمانوں اور زمین کی بادشاہی اسی کی ہے۔ (وہی) زندہ کرتا اور مارتا ہے۔ اور وہ ہر چیز پر قادر ہے.

Quran 57:3. Arabic: هُوَ ٱلْأَوَّلُ وَٱلْءَاخِرُ وَٱلظَّٰهِرُ وَٱلْبَاطِنُ ۖ وَهُوَ بِكُلِّ شَىْءٍ عَلِيمٌ. English: He is the First and the Last, the Ascendant and the Intimate, and He is, of all things, Knowing.. Urdu: وہ (سب سے) پہلا اور (سب سے) پچھلا اور (اپنی قدرتوں سے سب پر) ظاہر اور (اپنی ذات سے) پوشیدہ ہے اور وہ تمام چیزوں کو جانتا ہے.

Arabic: يُنَادُونَهُمْ أَلَمْ نَكُن مَّعَكُمْ ۖ قَالُوا۟ بَلَىٰ وَلَٰكِنَّكُمْ فَتَنتُمْ أَنفُسَكُمْ وَتَرَبَّصْتُمْ وَٱرْتَبْتُمْ وَغَرَّتْكُمُ ٱلْأَمَانِىُّ حَتَّىٰ جَآءَ أَمْرُ ٱللَّهِ وَغَرَّكُم بِٱللَّهِ ٱلْغَرُورُ. English: The hypocrites will call to the believers, "Were we not with you?" They will say, "Yes, but you afflicted yourselves and awaited [misfortune for us] and doubted, and wishful thinking deluded you until there came the command of Allah. And the Deceiver deceived you concerning Allah.. Urdu: تو منافق لوگ مومنوں سے کہیں گے کہ کیا ہم (دنیا میں) تمہارے ساتھ نہ…

Quran 57:28. Arabic: يَٰٓأَيُّهَا ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوا۟ ٱتَّقُوا۟ ٱللَّهَ وَءَامِنُوا۟ بِرَسُولِهِۦ يُؤْتِكُمْ كِفْلَيْنِ مِن رَّحْمَتِهِۦ وَيَجْعَل لَّكُمْ نُورًۭا تَمْشُونَ بِهِۦ وَيَغْفِرْ لَكُمْ ۚ وَٱللَّهُ غَفُورٌۭ رَّحِيمٌۭ. English: O you who have believed, fear Allah and believe in His Messenger; He will [then] give you a double portion of His mercy and make for you a light by which you will walk and forgive you; and Allah is Forgiving and Merciful.. q-0393.answer: Scholars classify the 114 surahs by where they were first revealed: approximately **86 surahs are Meccan** (revealed before Hijrah in Makkah) and **28 are Medinan** (revealed after Hijrah in Madinah). Meccan surahs often focus on faith, tawhid, and the Hereafter; Medinan surahs often address law, community, and governance. Individual surah pages show each surah's revelation type.

Surah Al-Hadid (57) — The Iron · 29 ayahs · Medinan

Main teachings:
• The Hellfire, according to Qatadah, Ibn Zayd and others.
• They give in charity with a good heart seeking the pleasure of Allah.
• It is the worthy shelter for you rather than any other residence, because of your disbelief and doubt, and how evil is the Fire for Final Destination.

q-0395.answer:
Surah Al-Mujaadila (58) — The Pleading Woman · 22 ayahs · Medinan

Main teachings:
• Surely, Allah is Aware of those who deserve this reward and those who are not worthy of it.
• Happiness, in their hearts and made faith dear to their hearts and happiness reside therein.
• The Almighty, All-Powerful has decreed that He shall prevail over His enemies.
• Do not befriend the deniers, even if they are among the closest relatives.

Full ayah text and tafsir are available in the sources below.

q-0397.answer: Scholars classify the 114 surahs by where they were first revealed: approximately **86 surahs are Meccan** (revealed before Hijrah in Makkah) and **28 are Medinan** (revealed after Hijrah in Madinah). Meccan surahs often focus on faith, tawhid, and the Hereafter; Medinan surahs often address law, community, and governance. Individual surah pages show each surah's revelation type.

q-0398.answer:
Surah Al-Mujaadila (58) — The Pleading Woman · 22 ayahs · Medinan

Main teachings:
• Surely, Allah is Aware of those who deserve this reward and those who are not worthy of it.
• Happiness, in their hearts and made faith dear to their hearts and happiness reside therein.
• The Almighty, All-Powerful has decreed that He shall prevail over His enemies.
• Do not befriend the deniers, even if they are among the closest relatives.

q-0399.answer:
Surah Al-Hashr (59) — The Exile · 24 ayahs · Medinan

Main teachings:
• Contemplate the end of those who defied Allah's command, contradicted His Messenger and denied His Book.
• The example of the Jews being deceived by the promises of the hypocrites, who said that they will help them if Muslims fight them, is that of the devil.
• There came to them from Allah what they did not expect or anticipate.
• Even though one might see them combining forces and think that these forces are harmonious, yet in reality, they are divided severely.
• They will not fight Muslims except from behind besieged fortified forts, because of their cowardice and fear of Muslims.

Full ayah text and tafsir are available in the sources below.

q-0401.answer: Scholars classify the 114 surahs by where they were first revealed: approximately **86 surahs are Meccan** (revealed before Hijrah in Makkah) and **28 are Medinan** (revealed after Hijrah in Madinah). Meccan surahs often focus on faith, tawhid, and the Hereafter; Medinan surahs often address law, community, and governance. Individual surah pages show each surah's revelation type.

q-0402.answer:
Surah Al-Hashr (59) — The Exile · 24 ayahs · Medinan

Main teachings:
• Contemplate the end of those who defied Allah's command, contradicted His Messenger and denied His Book.
• The example of the Jews being deceived by the promises of the hypocrites, who said that they will help them if Muslims fight them, is that of the devil.
• There came to them from Allah what they did not expect or anticipate.
• Even though one might see them combining forces and think that these forces are harmonious, yet in reality, they are divided severely.
• They will not fight Muslims except from behind besieged fortified forts, because of their cowardice and fear of Muslims.

Full ayah text and tafsir are available in the sources below.

q-0403.answer:
Surah Al-Mumtahana (60) — She that is to be examined · 13 ayahs · Medinan

Main teachings:
• Your only fault is that you believed in Allah, Lord of all that exists.
• You cannot follow Ibrahim's example as proof in the case mentioned here, as being allowed to ask Allah to forgive those who died on Shirk.
• Unless, and until, you worship Allah alone without partners and disbelieve in the idols and rivals that you worship besides Him.

Full ayah text and tafsir are available in the sources below.

q-0405.answer: Scholars classify the 114 surahs by where they were first revealed: approximately **86 surahs are Meccan** (revealed before Hijrah in Makkah) and **28 are Medinan** (revealed after Hijrah in Madinah). Meccan surahs often focus on faith, tawhid, and the Hereafter; Medinan surahs often address law, community, and governance. Individual surah pages show each surah's revelation type.

q-0406.answer:
Surah Al-Mumtahana (60) — She that is to be examined · 13 ayahs · Medinan

Main teachings:
• Your only fault is that you believed in Allah, Lord of all that exists.
• You cannot follow Ibrahim's example as proof in the case mentioned here, as being allowed to ask Allah to forgive those who died on Shirk.
• Unless, and until, you worship Allah alone without partners and disbelieve in the idols and rivals that you worship besides Him.

q-0407.answer:
Surah As-Saff (61) — The Ranks · 14 ayahs · Medinan

Main teachings:
• None is more unjust than he who lies about Allah and calls upon rivals and associates partners with Him, even while he is being invited to Tawhid and sincerely worshipping Him.
• We will support you with regards to the Message you have been sent with and will help you convey it.
• Whatever is in the heavens and whatever is on the earth exalts Allah, and He is the Exalted in Might, the Wise.
• O you who have believed, why do you say what you do not do?
• Great is hatred in the sight of Allah that you say what you do not do.

Full ayah text and tafsir are available in the sources below.

sources.snippet: Quran 61:1. Arabic: بِسْمِ ٱللَّهِ ٱلرَّحْمَٰنِ ٱلرَّحِيمِ سَبَّحَ لِلَّهِ مَا فِى ٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتِ وَمَا فِى ٱلْأَرْضِ ۖ وَهُوَ ٱلْعَزِيزُ ٱلْحَكِيمُ. English: Whatever is in the heavens and whatever is on the earth exalts Allah, and He is the Exalted in Might, the Wise.. Urdu: جو چیز آسمانوں میں ہے اور زمین میں ہے سب خدا کی تنزیہ کرتی ہے اور وہ غالب حکمت والا ہے.

Quran 61:2. Arabic: يَٰٓأَيُّهَا ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوا۟ لِمَ تَقُولُونَ مَا لَا تَفْعَلُونَ. English: O you who have believed, why do you say what you do not do?. Urdu: مومنو! تم ایسی باتیں کیوں کہا کرتے ہو جو کیا نہیں کرتے.

Quran 61:3. Arabic: كَبُرَ مَقْتًا عِندَ ٱللَّهِ أَن تَقُولُوا۟ مَا لَا تَفْعَلُونَ. English: Great is hatred in the sight of Allah that you say what you do not do.. Urdu: خدا اس بات سے سخت بیزار ہے کہ ایسی بات کہو جو کرو نہیں.

Quran 61:7. Arabic: وَمَنْ أَظْلَمُ مِمَّنِ ٱفْتَرَىٰ عَلَى ٱللَّهِ ٱلْكَذِبَ وَهُوَ يُدْعَىٰٓ إِلَى ٱلْإِسْلَٰمِ ۚ وَٱللَّهُ لَا يَهْدِى ٱلْقَوْمَ ٱلظَّٰلِمِينَ. English: And who is more unjust than one who invents about Allah untruth while he is being invited to Islam. And Allah does not guide the wrongdoing people.. Urdu: اور اس سے ظالم کون کہ بلایا تو جائے اسلام کی طرف اور وہ خدا پر جھوٹ بہتان باندھے۔ اور خدا ظالم لوگوں کو ہدایت نہیں دیا کرتا.

Quran 61:13. Arabic: وَأُخْرَىٰ تُحِبُّونَهَا ۖ نَصْرٌۭ مِّنَ ٱللَّهِ وَفَتْحٌۭ قَرِيبٌۭ ۗ وَبَشِّرِ ٱلْمُؤْمِنِينَ. English: And [you will obtain] another [favor] that you love - victory from Allah and an imminent conquest; and give good tidings to the believers.. Urdu: جو چیز آسمانوں میں ہے اور زمین میں ہے سب خدا کی تنزیہ کرتی ہے اور وہ غالب حکمت والا ہے.

Quran 61:2. Arabic: يَٰٓأَيُّهَا ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوا۟ لِمَ تَقُولُونَ مَا لَا تَفْعَلُونَ. English: O you who have believed, why do you say what you do not do?. Urdu: مومنو! تم ایسی باتیں کیوں کہا کرتے ہو جو کیا نہیں کرتے.

Quran 61:3. Arabic: كَبُرَ مَقْتًا عِندَ ٱللَّهِ أَن تَقُولُوا۟ مَا لَا تَفْعَلُونَ. English: Great is hatred in the sight of Allah that you say what you do not do.. Urdu: خدا اس بات سے سخت بیزار ہے کہ ایسی بات کہو جو کرو نہیں.

Quran 61:7. Arabic: وَمَنْ أَظْلَمُ مِمَّنِ ٱفْتَرَىٰ عَلَى ٱللَّهِ ٱلْكَذِبَ وَهُوَ يُدْعَىٰٓ إِلَى ٱلْإِسْلَٰمِ ۚ وَٱللَّهُ لَا يَهْدِى ٱلْقَوْمَ ٱلظَّٰلِمِينَ. English: And who is more unjust than one who invents about Allah untruth while he is being invited to Islam. And Allah does not guide the wrongdoing people.. Urdu: اور اس سے ظالم کون کہ بلایا تو جائے اسلام کی طرف اور وہ خدا پر جھوٹ بہتان باندھے۔ اور خدا ظالم لوگوں کو ہدایت نہیں دیا کرتا.

Quran 61:13. Arabic: وَأُخْرَىٰ تُحِبُّونَهَا ۖ نَصْرٌۭ مِّنَ ٱللَّهِ وَفَتْحٌۭ قَرِيبٌۭ ۗ وَبَشِّرِ ٱلْمُؤْمِنِينَ. English: And [you will obtain] another [favor] that you love - victory from Allah and an imminent conquest; and give good tidings to the believers.. Urdu: اور ایک اور چیز جس کو تم بہت چاہتے ہو (یعنی تمہیں) خدا کی طرف سے مدد (نصیب ہوگی) اور فتح عنقریب ہوگی اور مومنوں کو (اس کی) خوشخبری سنا دو.

q-0409.answer: Scholars classify the 114 surahs by where they were first revealed: approximately **86 surahs are Meccan** (revealed before Hijrah in Makkah) and **28 are Medinan** (revealed after Hijrah in Madinah). Meccan surahs often focus on faith, tawhid, and the Hereafter; Medinan surahs often address law, community, and governance. Individual surah pages show each surah's revelation type.

sources.snippet: Quran 3:3. Arabic: نَزَّلَ عَلَيْكَ ٱلْكِتَٰبَ بِٱلْحَقِّ مُصَدِّقًۭا لِّمَا بَيْنَ يَدَيْهِ وَأَنزَلَ ٱلتَّوْرَىٰةَ وَٱلْإِنجِيلَ. Quran 17:1. Arabic: بِسْمِ ٱللَّهِ ٱلرَّحْمَٰنِ ٱلرَّحِيمِ سُبْحَٰنَ ٱلَّذِىٓ أَسْرَىٰ بِعَبْدِهِۦ لَيْلًۭا مِّنَ ٱلْمَسْجِدِ ٱلْحَرَامِ إِلَى ٱلْمَسْجِدِ ٱلْأَقْصَا ٱلَّذِى بَٰرَكْنَا حَوْلَهُۥ لِنُرِيَهُۥ مِنْ ءَايَٰتِنَآ ۚ إِنَّهُۥ هُوَ ٱلسَّمِيعُ ٱلْبَصِيرُ. English: Exalted is He who took His Servant by night from al-Masjid al-Haram to al-Masjid al-Aqsa, whose surroundings We have blessed, to show him of Our signs. Indeed, He is the Hearing, the Seeing.. Urdu: وہ (ذات) پاک ہے جو ایک رات اپنے بندے کو مسجدالحرام یعنی (خانہٴ کعبہ) سے مسجد اقصیٰ (یعنی بیت المقدس) تک جس کے گردا گرد ہم نے برک…

q-0410.answer:
Surah As-Saff (61) — The Ranks · 14 ayahs · Medinan

Main teachings:
• None is more unjust than he who lies about Allah and calls upon rivals and associates partners with Him, even while he is being invited to Tawhid and sincerely worshipping Him.
• We will support you with regards to the Message you have been sent with and will help you convey it.
• Whatever is in the heavens and whatever is on the earth exalts Allah, and He is the Exalted in Might, the Wise.
• O you who have believed, why do you say what you do not do?
• Great is hatred in the sight of Allah that you say what you do not do.

Full ayah text and tafsir are available in the sources below.

q-0411.answer:
Surah Al-Jumu'a (62) — Friday · 11 ayahs · Medinan

Main teachings:
• Whatever is in the heavens and whatever is on the earth is exalting Allah, the Sovereign, the Pure, the Exalted in Might, the Wise.
• It is He who has sent among the unlettered a Messenger from themselves reciting to them His verses and purifying them and teaching them the Book and wisdom - although they were before in clear error -
• And [to] others of them who have not yet joined them. And He is the Exalted in Might, the Wise.
• The example of those who were entrusted with the Torah and then did not take it on is like that of a donkey who carries volumes [of books]. Wretched is the example of the people who deny the signs of Allah. And Allah does not guide the wrongdoing people.
• And when the prayer has been concluded, disperse within the land and seek from the bounty of Allah, and remember Allah often that you may succeed.

Full ayah text and tafsir are available in the sources below.

English: Whatever is in the heavens and whatever is on the earth is exalting Allah, the Sovereign, the Pure, the Exalted in Might, the Wise.. Urdu: جو چیز آسمانوں میں ہے اور جو چیز زمین میں ہے سب خدا کی تسبیح کرتی ہے جو بادشاہ حقیقی پاک ذات زبردست حکمت والا ہے.

Quran 62:2. Arabic: هُوَ ٱلَّذِى بَعَثَ فِى ٱلْأُمِّيِّۦنَ رَسُولًۭا مِّنْهُمْ يَتْلُوا۟ عَلَيْهِمْ ءَايَٰتِهِۦ وَيُزَكِّيهِمْ وَيُعَلِّمُهُمُ ٱلْكِتَٰبَ وَٱلْحِكْمَةَ وَإِن كَانُوا۟ مِن قَبْلُ لَفِى ضَلَٰلٍۢ مُّبِينٍۢ. English: It is He who has sent among the unlettered a Messenger from themselves reciting to them His verses and purifying them and teaching them the Book and wisdom - although they were before in clear error -. Urdu: وہی تو ہے جس نے ان پڑھوں میں ان ہی میں سے (محمدﷺ) کو پیغمبر (بنا کر) بھیجا جو ان کے سامنے اس کی آیتیں پڑھتے اور ان کو پاک کرتے اور (خدا کی) کتاب اور دانائی سکھاتے…

Quran 62:3. Arabic: وَءَاخَرِينَ مِنْهُمْ لَمَّا يَلْحَقُوا۟ بِهِمْ ۚ وَهُوَ ٱلْعَزِيزُ ٱلْحَكِيمُ. English: And [to] others of them who have not yet joined them. And He is the Exalted in Might, the Wise.. Urdu: اور ان میں سے اور لوگوں کی طرف بھی (ان کو بھیجا ہے) جو ابھی ان (مسلمانوں سے) نہیں ملے۔ اور وہ غالب حکمت والا ہے.

Quran 62:5. Arabic: مَثَلُ ٱلَّذِينَ حُمِّلُوا۟ ٱلتَّوْرَىٰةَ ثُمَّ لَمْ يَحْمِلُوهَا كَمَثَلِ ٱلْحِمَارِ يَحْمِلُ أَسْفَارًۢا ۚ بِئْسَ مَثَلُ ٱلْقَوْمِ ٱلَّذِينَ كَذَّبُوا۟ بِـَٔايَٰتِ ٱللَّهِ ۚ وَٱللَّهُ لَا يَهْدِى ٱلْقَوْمَ ٱلظَّٰلِمِينَ. English: The example of those who were entrusted with the Torah and then did not take it on is like that of a donkey who carries volumes [of books]. Wretched is the example of the people who deny the signs of Allah. And Allah does not guide the wrongdoing people.. Urdu: جن لوگوں (کے سر) پر تورات لدوائی گئی پھر انہوں نے اس (کے بار تعمیل) کو نہ اٹھایا ان ک…

Quran 62:10. Arabic: فَإِذَا قُضِيَتِ ٱلصَّلَوٰةُ فَٱنتَشِرُوا۟ فِى ٱلْأَرْضِ وَٱبْتَغُوا۟ مِن فَضْلِ ٱللَّهِ وَٱذْكُرُوا۟ ٱللَّهَ كَثِيرًۭا لَّعَلَّكُمْ تُفْلِحُونَ. English: And when the prayer has been concluded, disperse within the land and seek from the bounty of Allah, and remember Allah often that you may succeed.. Urdu: پھر جب نماز ہوچکے تو اپنی اپنی راہ لو اور خدا کا فضل تلاش کرو اور خدا کو بہت بہت یاد کرتے رہو تاکہ نجات پاؤ.

q-0414.answer:
Surah Al-Jumu'a (62) — Friday · 11 ayahs · Medinan

Main teachings:
• Whatever is in the heavens and whatever is on the earth is exalting Allah, the Sovereign, the Pure, the Exalted in Might, the Wise.
• It is He who has sent among the unlettered a Messenger from themselves reciting to them His verses and purifying them and teaching them the Book and wisdom - although they were before in clear error -
• And [to] others of them who have not yet joined them. And He is the Exalted in Might, the Wise.
• The example of those who were entrusted with the Torah and then did not take it on is like that of a donkey who carries volumes [of books]. Wretched is the example of the people who deny the signs of Allah. And Allah does not guide the wrongdoing people.
• And when the prayer has been concluded, disperse within the land and seek from the bounty of Allah, and remember Allah often that you may succeed.

Full ayah text and tafsir are available in the sources below.

q-0415.answer:
Surah Al-Munaafiqoon (63) — The Hypocrites · 11 ayahs · Medinan

Main teachings:
• He has decreed them to be hypocrites because they reverted from faith to disbelief and exchanged guidance for misguidance.
• The hypocrites shield themselves from Muslims when they falsely and sinfully swear to be what they are not in reality.
• When the hypocrites come to you, they announce this statement and pretend to believe in it.

Full ayah text and tafsir are available in the sources below.

Arabic: حُرِّمَتْ عَلَيْكُمُ ٱلْمَيْتَةُ وَٱلدَّمُ وَلَحْمُ ٱلْخِنزِيرِ وَمَآ أُهِلَّ لِغَيْرِ ٱللَّهِ بِهِۦ وَٱلْمُنْخَنِقَةُ وَٱلْمَوْقُوذَةُ وَٱلْمُتَرَدِّيَةُ وَٱلنَّطِيحَةُ وَمَآ أَكَلَ ٱلسَّبُعُ إِلَّا مَا ذَكَّيْتُمْ وَمَا ذُبِحَ عَلَى ٱلنُّصُبِ وَأَن تَسْتَقْسِمُوا۟ بِٱلْأَزْلَٰمِ ۚ ذَٰلِكُمْ فِسْقٌ ۗ ٱلْيَوْمَ يَئِسَ ٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا۟ مِن دِينِكُمْ فَلَا تَخْشَوْهُمْ وَٱخْشَوْنِ ۚ ٱلْيَوْمَ أَكْمَلْتُ لَكُمْ دِينَكُمْ وَأَتْمَمْتُ عَلَيْكُمْ نِعْمَتِى وَرَضِيتُ لَكُمُ ٱلْإِسْلَٰمَ دِينًۭا ۚ فَمَنِ ٱضْطُرَّ فِى مَخْمَصَةٍ غَيْرَ مُتَجَانِفٍۢ لِّإِثْمٍۢ ۙ فَإِنَّ ٱللَّهَ…

Arabic: بِسْمِ ٱللَّهِ ٱلرَّحْمَٰنِ ٱلرَّحِيمِ سُبْحَٰنَ ٱلَّذِىٓ أَسْرَىٰ بِعَبْدِهِۦ لَيْلًۭا مِّنَ ٱلْمَسْجِدِ ٱلْحَرَامِ إِلَى ٱلْمَسْجِدِ ٱلْأَقْصَا ٱلَّذِى بَٰرَكْنَا حَوْلَهُۥ لِنُرِيَهُۥ مِنْ ءَايَٰتِنَآ ۚ إِنَّهُۥ هُوَ ٱلسَّمِيعُ ٱلْبَصِيرُ.
